### Issue URL (Social Widget) [https://www.nw-siken.com/s/kakomon/27_aki/am1_8.html](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nw-siken.com%2Fs%2Fkakomon%2F27_aki%2Fam1_8.html) ### Comment > > ### Bug Report: Social share buttons are no longer blocked > > #### Description > On the target website (reported in this issue), the social media share buttons are no longer blocked and remain visible. > > #### Conditions for Reproduction > This issue occurs **only** when both of the following filters are added and enabled as **Custom Filters** (rather than enabling them from the app's default filter list): > * Japanese Filter (Full / Unoptimized): `https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/7.txt` > * Social Media Filter (Full / Unoptimized): `https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/4.txt` > > **Notes on when the issue does NOT occur:** > * Adding other filters as custom filters does not trigger the issue. > * Default Social Media Filter + Custom Japanese Filter -> Works as expected. > * Custom Social Media Filter + Default Japanese Filter -> Works as expected. > * The issue strictly occurs when **both** are registered as custom filters. > > #### Workaround > Adding a user rule to hide the specific element temporarily resolves the issue. > Interestingly, adding the exact rule that should already be included in the Social Media Filter as a user rule also fixes it. This indicates that the rule itself works fine, but something within the filter combination is overriding or negating it. > > #### Possible Cause > I suspect that a rule present in the full (unoptimized) version but removed in the optimized (built-in) version of one of these filters is interfering with the hiding of the share buttons. > Since adding filters with even more rules than the Japanese Filter (e.g., the Cookie Notices filter) does not reproduce the issue, I have concluded this is not caused by hitting the iOS Content Blocker rule limit. > > #### Why using "Optimized Filters" is not a solution > I browse a massive number of websites for both work and personal use. Reporting broken sites caused by rules stripped during optimization defeats the purpose. As long as I am within the iOS rule limit, using full versions via custom filters should fundamentally work. > > #### Request > Please investigate and fix the cause, or explain the root cause of this conflict. > I am happy to provide logs, screenshots, exported settings, or specific related rules if needed. Please let me know before closing this as "Cannot reproduce"—I am fully willing to assist in confirming the reproduction steps. > > Additionally, the operator of this website runs several other websites using the exact same layout (listed below). It would be greatly appreciated if these could be addressed as well. If I need to create separate issues for them, please let me know. > > **Related Websites:** > ``` > https://www.pm-siken.com/s/kakomon/30_haru/am1_10.html > https://www.db-siken.com/s/kakomon/06_aki/am1_6.html > https://www.fe-siken.com/s/kakomon/02_menjo/q6.html > https://www.sg-siken.com/s/kakomon/31_haru/q5.html > https://www.itpassportsiken.com/s/kakomon/28_aki/q9.html > https://www.sc-siken.com/s/kakomon/01_aki/am1_9.html > https://www.ap-siken.com/s/kakomon/05_haru/q7.html > https://fp1-siken.com/kakomon/2022_5/07.html > https://fp2-siken.com/kakomon/2024_9/21.html > https://fp3-siken.com/kakomon/2019_9/08.html > ``` > > Thank you. > > > > > > > > > > > > ### Screenshots

issue.body:
# 죄송합니다. 해당 웹 사이트는 애드쉴드(AdShield, Inc)에 의해 감염되었습니다.

안타깝게도 이 웹 사이트는 안티 애드블록 전문 회사인 애드쉴드의 서비스에 의해 보호받고 있어 일반적인 애드블록 규칙로는 처리가 까다롭습니다.
애드쉴드는 대한민국 정부의 기술 창업 지원 프로그램으로부터 최대 2년에 7억원을 받습니다.

이러한 기록은 [여기](https://github.com/List-KR/List-KR/issues?q=label%3Aad-shield+)에서 검증하실 수 있습니다.
대한민국 정부의 지원 사실은 [여기](https://www.venturesquare.net/857777)에서 확인하실 수 있습니다.

## 유저스크립트 설치
[microShield 유저스크립트](https://github.com/List-KR/microShield)를 설치하여 애드쉴드 광고를 차단하시길 바랍니다.
한국어로 작성되어 있는 설치 가이드라인은 [이 URL](https://community.list-kr.com/docs/AdGuard/Userscripts/microShield)를 방문하여 확인해주세요.


## 그래도 문제가 있으신가요?
유저스크립트를 사용했을 때 발생하는 문제는 [이 이슈 트래커](https://github.com/List-KR/microShield/issues)로 알려주세요.
기타 문제는 [이 곳](https://github.com/List-KR/List-KR/issues)으로 알려주세요.
GitHub 이슈를 사용하시기 어렵다면, filters@adguard.com 로 문의해주세요.

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973
